system.description:
Your concealment no longer roots you in place. You fade from view and walk freely among others, unnoticed as you pass.

Any time you are hidden from sight, invoke this power (cross your arms before your chest). Once concealed you may move about at a walk and remain unnoticed. The concealment holds as long as you do not speak, make loud noises or interact with your environment - you become visible at once if you open a door, attack, exert Presence or, say, knock over a vase. Retest Stealth.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
